mob_drop.note: ItemId -> BNpcNameId; MobSpawn can supply multiple observed places; quantities and probabilities absent.

dungeon_chest.note: ItemId -> ChestId -> DungeonChest; concrete chest, coordinates, optional Min/Max/Probability.

dungeon_boss.note: ItemId -> duty + FightNo -> DungeonBoss; Quantity retained.

dungeon_boss_chest.note: ItemId -> duty + FightNo + CofferNo; Quantity retained.

dungeon_drop.note: ItemId -> duty only; not silently upgraded to a particular boss or coffer.

fate.note: ItemId -> FateId; no contribution tier, quantity, trigger or probability.

gardening_crossbreed.note: ItemResultId is output, both ItemRequirement IDs are joint inputs; soil/layout/chance absent.

retainer_random.note: ItemId -> RetainerTaskRandomId; join task metadata separately.

submarine.note: ItemId -> sector; LootTier and normal/poor/optimal quantity ranges retained.

store.note: International store product URL and USD cents; not equivalent to CN store availability/pricing.

fieldop_coffer.note: Type + ChestType + optional observed Min/Max/Probability; no item source ID.

desynth.note: ItemSupplementSource=1; SourceItemId is consumed/opened/converted to output ItemId. Min/Max/Probability preserved as nullable; no complete route/unlock proof.
